title: Invalid platform configurations
description: Unknown --platforms without Scan.toml, unreachable/invalid plugin URLs, a platform without path, a missing local JAR. A plugin URL is downloaded only when --platforms names the platform, so an unreachable URL is harmless without it. A path that is neither a file nor a URL fails when Scan.toml is read, whatever the command line.

steps.name: Unreachable plugin URL, not selected
steps.note: The URL is not downloaded, since --platforms does not name the platform, so the scan succeeds.

steps.name: Unreachable plugin URL, selected
steps.note: The URL is downloaded only now, because --platforms names the platform, and the download fails before anything is scanned.

steps.name: Local JAR that does not exist
Plugin JAR without the named platform, not selected
steps.note: The JAR is loaded only for a selected platform, so the scan succeeds.

steps.name: Plugin JAR without the named platform, selected
steps.note: Error, exit 1: the recorder JAR provides recorder and recorder2, not notInJar.
